subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support update signal-cli configuration and pass explicit preview fields, and what default plus per-account semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but default behavior, linked-device failures, and untrusted preview metadata handling are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Default-safe explicit pass-through
options.body: Add a Signal plugin setting that preserves existing behavior by default, passes only caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and avoids automatic metadata fetching.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the broader link-preview metadata boundary, then implement the Signal config against that decision.

options.title: Default-on previews
options.body: Enable Signal previews by default with an escape hatch, accepting a higher compatibility and security-review burden.

recommendation.title: Default-safe explicit pass-through
recommendation.body: Add a Signal plugin setting that preserves existing behavior by default, passes only caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and avoids automatic metadata fetching.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Signal send/config/docs and already provided item-specific maintainer-facing context.
